Changelog

All notable changes to defuss-shadcn, auto-generated on each release.

v0.7.15

September 06, 2026 fe26cbd
  • SKILL.md: dist/SKILL.md generated per build from src/SKILL_tpl.md + skill frontmatter — the agent entry point (integration, philosophy, dist/ layout, per-component index)
  • all 55 component skills: required name/why/when/where/supportedStates frontmatter (AGENTS.md "Component skill template"); verify gates "skill frontmatter" + "SKILL.md ↔ skills"
  • component-skills.html + index + README document dist/SKILL.md as the discovery point for agents
  • tests/skill.test.ts: frontmatter parser, index block shape, screenshot naming per state

v0.7.14

September 06, 2026 da3c0d5
  • First release as defuss-shadcn — forked from codylindley/shadcn-html (original idea and implementation by Cody Lindley) at commit f6d308d, September 05, 2026; v0.7.14 continues the original v0.7.13-alpha line and every commit below is post-fork work
  • README: doc-site e2e covers the command-palette search, not the removed sidebar filter
  • docs search: header box opens the command palette, fed by a generated index
  • docs search box moves into the header, next to the version badge
  • footer credit + tagline rewritten (user copy); sidebar author block removed
  • docs header brand fixed (shadcn-html -> defuss-shadcn); footer can never go stale again
  • sync README ↔ index.html hero sentence; add commit-window gate
  • index.html dogfoods the CDN install; README↔index parity rule + gate; docs e2e
  • docs/ publishes only the documentation site (no more full dist/ copy)
  • README: credits — forked from codylindley/shadcn-html (original idea and implementation by Cody Lindley); the Author line conflated the two people (kyr0.com is Aron Homberg)
  • no window globals: everything lives under globalThis._defussShadcn (AGENTS.md)
  • README: point to ARCH.md, drop stale rollout-gap note (ratchets now empty)
  • ARCH.md: the self-verification proof loop, documented
  • e2e coverage for all 29 CSS-only components (rollout complete)
  • all 16 legacy components: honor prefers-reduced-motion (accessibility CSS)
  • avatar, image, sidebar, toast, context-menu: State API + e2e (batch 6, final legacy five)
  • calendar, color-picker, combobox, tree-view: State API + e2e (batch 5)
  • slider, number-input, carousel, sortable: State API + e2e (batch 4)
  • tabs, toggle, toggle-group, toolbar: State API + e2e (batch 3)
  • sheet, alert-dialog, command, navigation-menu: State API + e2e (batch 2)
  • popover, tooltip, dropdown: State API + e2e (batch 1)
  • README: document State API, TypeScript test tree, screenshots, expanded verify contract, docs/ mirror
  • docs: mirror dist/ → docs/ for GitHub Pages; typecheck + mirror freshness in verify
  • tests: port e2e runner, server, helpers and suites to TypeScript
  • verify: 8 new Pareto checks (escaping sentinel, reduced-motion, init idempotency, doc refs, linkedom link check, fixture↔CSS parity, portable paths, render drift)
  • verify+AGENTS: mandate refactor-source-first, then-e2e migration order
  • verify: state API messages give explicit refactor directive for missing states array
  • verify: code↔skill↔docs variant parity + uncommitted-tree warning
  • wip
  • initial after refactoring of fork
